title: Plaid theme
description: A cool fintech light theme: a pale blue-white page, navy ink, near-black pill buttons, a teal-mint highlight and a bright cyan-blue glow that together make the blue-to-aqua gradient bands, periwinkle and purple for rims and figures, lavender for soft notes. Figtree throughout, a light high-contrast serif for big figures, Inconsolata for code. A deep navy dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's dark bands (AI band, API band, footer) use the foreground colour as their surface in light mode and the card colour in dark mode
sets --typeface-serif (Fraunces) for big figures; blocks read it as var(--typeface-serif, Georgia)
